title: Branding Agency in Tashkent: Packages & Prices
description: Full-cycle branding in Tashkent: strategy, logo, visual identity and brand book. Packages from $1,900, an identity in 2–6 weeks. Talk to OneBranding.
lead: OneBranding builds brands from strategy to the last touchpoint: positioning, logo, visual identity and the rules that hold it together. Branding packages start at $1,900; a focused identity takes 2 to 6 weeks.
intro: Branding is the complete development of your business as a strong, recognisable brand. It starts with research into your market and audience, turns that into a strategy and positioning, and only then into a logo, colours, typography and the visual system that sets you apart from competitors.

We work with companies in Uzbekistan and abroad, in Uzbek, Russian and English, remotely or at our office on Amir Temur Street in Tashkent. Whether you are launching a new brand or renewing one that no longer fits, you get one team for strategy, design and the applications your brand needs.

includes.title: What branding includes
items: Naming, when the brand needs a name
Visual identity: colours, typography, graphic elements
Brand book with clear usage rules
Applications you need: packaging, print, social media, website
Final files for print and web, plus source files

steps.name: Brief and research
steps.text: We learn your business, goals and audience, and study the market and your competitors.

steps.name: Strategy and concept
steps.text: We define the positioning and the idea the whole brand is built on.

steps.name: Design
steps.text: We design the logo and the identity system around that idea.

steps.name: Refinement
steps.text: Each stage includes rounds of revisions with your feedback; you approve it before we move on.

steps.name: Hand-over
steps.text: You receive the brand book, final files in every format you need and the source files.

timeline.title: How long it takes
timeline.text: A focused identity usually takes 2 to 6 weeks. A full brand system with naming, packaging or a website takes longer. We agree on the timeline with you before we start.

items.q: How much does branding cost in Tashkent?
items.a: Our branding packages are Launch Base from $1,900, One Pro from $2,900 and Global ultimate from $5,900. The final price depends on the scope we agree in the brief; a logo on its own starts at $900.

items.q: What is the difference between branding and a logo?
items.a: A logo is one sign. Branding is the whole system around it: strategy, positioning, visual identity and the brand book whose rules keep every touchpoint consistent, from packaging to your website.
Yes. We start with an audit of your current brand and market, keep what still works and renew what no longer fits your business or your audience, so customers still recognise you.

items.q: What do I receive at the end?
items.a: All final files in the formats you need (vector, print and web), the brand book with usage rules, the source files and every application we agreed on at the start.

items.q: What do you need from us to start?
items.a: A short conversation about your business, goals and audience. We send you a brief, agree on scope, timeline and price, sign a contract and start with research.

cta.title: Tell us about your brand
cta.text: Fill in the brief and we will come back with a proposal: scope, timeline and price.
